definitions.name: Engine
definitions.description: Consumes fuel and air. Produces exhaust. Requires 6 rps to start. Fit air manifold, fuel manifold, input and output oil manifolds, input and output coolant manifolds. Max temp 160C. Compatible with small engine wheel, small gearbox.

definitions.name: Engine Wheel
definitions.description: Belt output of a small engine. Turns at engine speed; a pulley wheel on its belt turns 2.5 times faster. Reverse flips belt direction.

definitions.name: Liquid Tank
definitions.description: Holds water, petrol or oil, 0.5 L per voxel; stretch to size. Ruptures on hard impact; explodes holding over 10 L of petrol. Fits liquid ports and a liquid fill port.

definitions.name: Radiator
definitions.description: Cools its liquid toward air temperature. Fit a radiator fan for more cooling. Holds 3 L; stretch for more. Circulate coolant through it with a pump. Leaks when damaged.

definitions.name: Wheel
definitions.description: Fits car, van, quadbike and 4x4 wheel items. Drive from torque face. Steers up to 32 degrees from steering mechanical link. Brake link 0 to 1.

definitions.name: Gear Track
definitions.description: Links a lower shaft to a parallel upper shaft at 1:1, same direction. Stretch to set spacing.

definitions.name: Battery
definitions.description: Holds a battery item of the same type, fitted by hand. 4 kWh. Fit electric port. Charged by an alternator on the same network. Damage empties it.

definitions.name: Steering Wheel
definitions.description: Mount on a seat main control face. Mechanical links: steering -1 to 1, left and right pedals 0 to 1.

definitions.name: Seat
definitions.description: Takes a steering wheel, flight stick or flight yoke on its main control face and up to 8 throttles or shifters on its side faces. Controls must be the same way up as the seat; one facing backwards is inverted.

definitions.name: Oil Filter
definitions.description: Fit two liquid ports and an oil filter item. Oil passes only with a filter fitted. Removes pollutant from oil.

definitions.name: Gearbox
definitions.description: Splits input to left and right outputs at a set ratio. Outputs turn together. Ratio set by input and output properties, 1 to 8. Mechanical link above 0.75 disconnects both outputs, below 0.25 reconnects.

definitions.name: Gearbox
definitions.description: Fits a large engine. Shifts pneumatically: fit two gas ports, first placed shifts up, second shifts down. A pulse above 29.4 kPa shifts once and must drop below 19.6 kPa before the next. Stretch for 2 to 8 gears.

definitions.name: Button
definitions.description: Momentary. Mechanical link reads 1 while held.

definitions.name: Slider
definitions.description: Hold either end to slide, 1 s for full travel. Mechanical link reads 0 to 1 and holds position.

definitions.name: 7 Segment LCD Display
definitions.description: Shows display value data input as 1 digit, 0 to 9. Negative values show 0. Requires a powered microcontroller on the data network.

definitions.name: Indicator Light
definitions.description: Lights when mechanical link reads 1 or illuminated data input is set.

definitions.name: Switch
definitions.description: Latching. Each press toggles mechanical link between 0 and 1.

definitions.name: Switch
definitions.description: Tap to toggle mechanical link between 0 and 0.5. Hold 0.5 s to read 1 while held.

definitions.name: Alternator
definitions.description: Driven by torque face. Charges the electric network through an electric port. Output rises with rps, peaking at 1.1 kW at 100 rps.

definitions.name: Electric Motor
definitions.description: Draws up to 10 kW. Fit electric port. Runs at 30 rps whenever powered. Reverse and power set in properties. Target rps can be set by data link.

definitions.name: Electric Motor
definitions.description: Draws up to 60 kW. Fit electric port. Runs at 30 rps whenever powered. Reverse and power set in properties. Target rps can be set by data link.

definitions.name: Handbrake
definitions.description: Mechanical link reads 1 when on, 0 when off. Toggle by interacting, or from a seat with the button set in properties.

definitions.name: Air Filter
definitions.description: Draws outside air into a large gas pipe. Fits an air filter item.

definitions.name: Liquid Pump
definitions.description: Driven by torque face. Fit two liquid ports; pumps from the first fitted to the second. Reverse the shaft or set reverse in properties to swap direction. Flow factor set in properties.

definitions.name: Pulley Wheel
definitions.description: Belt wheel on a torque face, radius 0.04 m. Belt to an engine wheel or pulley wheel with the belt tool. Speed scales by radius ratio. Reverse flips direction.

definitions.name: Liquid Port
definitions.description: Fits any liquid port face. Small pipe node. Pipe links only join nodes of the same size.

definitions.name: Liquid Port
definitions.description: Fits any liquid port face. Small pipe node. Pipe links only join nodes of the same size.

definitions.name: Liquid Port
definitions.description: Fits any liquid port face. Large pipe node. Pipe links only join nodes of the same size.

definitions.name: Liquid Port
definitions.description: Fits any liquid port face. Large pipe node. Pipe links only join nodes of the same size.

definitions.name: Gas Port
definitions.description: Fits any gas port face. Small pipe node. Pipe links only join nodes of the same size.

definitions.name: Exhaust Manifold
definitions.description: Bolts to an engine exhaust port. Small pipe. Exhaust at 300C. Back pressure above 39 kPa cuts engine power; the engine stops at 196 kPa.

definitions.name: Air Manifold
definitions.description: Bolts to an engine air port. Large pipe. Throttle is a mechanical link input. Intake pressure above 9.8 kPa adds power, up to double at 98 kPa.

definitions.name: Fuel Manifold
definitions.description: Bolts to an engine fuel port. Small pipe. Draws fuel itself once the engine turns; no pump needed.

definitions.name: Oil Manifold
definitions.description: Bolts to an oil port on an engine or jet part. Small pipe. Fit two so oil circulates through an oil filter.

definitions.name: Coolant Manifold
definitions.description: Bolts to an engine coolant port. Small pipe. Fit two so coolant circulates through a radiator.

definitions.name: Electric Port
definitions.description: Plugs into a port socket. Link ports with the electric tool to form an electric network.

definitions.name: Gas Pipe Junction
definitions.description: Joins three small gas pipe nodes.

definitions.name: Mechanical Invert
definitions.description: Output = -1 x input.

definitions.name: Mechanical Max
definitions.description: Output = the larger of inputs A and B.

definitions.name: Mechanical Min
definitions.description: Output = the smaller of inputs A and B.

definitions.name: Electric Relay
definitions.description: Switch for an electric network. Fitted electric ports are joined while on. Activate mechanical link: on above 0.75, off below 0.25.

definitions.name: Gas Vent
definitions.description: Opens a small gas pipe to the atmosphere. Vents exhaust and draws in air.

definitions.name: Gas Tank
definitions.description: Stores air or exhaust under pressure. 9.5 L plus 3.3 L per voxel of stretch. Fits gas ports.

definitions.name: Gas Port
definitions.description: Fits any gas port face. Small pipe node. Pipe links only join nodes of the same size.

definitions.name: Liquid Fill Port
definitions.description: Bolts to a liquid tank or radiator port. Fill or siphon with a hand-held container such as a jerry can.

definitions.name: Microcontroller
definitions.description: Draws 10 W. Fit electric port. Runs a script that reads and writes every component on its data network. Powers displays and backlights on that network.

definitions.name: Data Port
definitions.description: Plugs into a port socket. Link ports with the data tool to form a data network.

definitions.name: Gas Valve
definitions.description: Diverter on a small gas pipe. Inlet feeds the right outlet while mechanical link is below 0.25, the left outlet above 0.75.

definitions.name: Gearbox
definitions.description: Fixed ratio between two torque faces. Ratio set by input and output properties, 1 to 8 each. Reverse flips output direction.

definitions.name: Engine
definitions.description: Consumes fuel and air. Produces exhaust. Requires 6 rps to start. Fit air manifold, fuel manifold, input and output oil manifolds, input and output coolant manifolds. Max temp 160C. Compatible with large engine wheel, large gearbox.

definitions.name: Engine Wheel
definitions.description: Belt output of a large engine. Turns at engine speed; a pulley wheel on its belt turns 6.7 times faster. Reverse flips belt direction.

definitions.name: Air Filter
definitions.description: Draws outside air into a large gas pipe. Fits an air filter item.

definitions.name: Short Shifter
definitions.description: Mount on a seat control face. Momentary: mechanical link reads 1 pushed forward, -1 pulled back, 0 at rest. Moved with program 1 and 2.

definitions.name: Radiator Fan
definitions.description: Fits the fan face of a radiator. Draws 250 W. Fit electric port. Cooling scales with fan size relative to the radiator.

definitions.name: Radiator
definitions.description: Cools its liquid toward air temperature. Fit a radiator fan for more cooling. Holds 12 L; stretch for more. Circulate coolant through it with a pump. Leaks when damaged.

definitions.name: Exhaust Manifold
definitions.description: Bolts to an engine exhaust port. Large pipe. Exhaust at 300C. Back pressure above 39 kPa cuts engine power; the engine stops at 196 kPa.

definitions.name: Gas Vent
definitions.description: Opens a large gas pipe to the atmosphere. Vents exhaust and draws in air.

definitions.name: Fuel Manifold
definitions.description: Bolts to an engine fuel port. Large pipe. Draws fuel itself once the engine turns; no pump needed.

definitions.name: Oil Manifold
definitions.description: Bolts to an oil port on an engine or jet part. Large pipe. Fit two so oil circulates through an oil filter.

definitions.name: Coolant Manifold
definitions.description: Bolts to an engine coolant port. Large pipe. Fit two so coolant circulates through a radiator.

definitions.name: Liquid Bracket
definitions.description: Straight pipe fitting, large liquid node at each end.

definitions.name: Liquid Reducer
definitions.description: Joins a small liquid pipe node to a large one.
